title: Add a failing test that storing the same attempt and role again does not post a second comment, and that storing a verdict with no pull request record leaves the verdict stored and does not call the forge. Then implement that behavior. Verify the test fails with `node --test test/review-comment.test.mjs` before the edit, and passes with the same command after it.
acceptanceCriteria: Repeat posts and a missing pull request record do not call the forge again.
